payload.summary: The Cabinet meeting page for 11 February 2026. The Home Options revisions are item 12, “To agree an update to the Home Options allocation policy”, immediately after item 11, the homelessness strategy the same consultation covered. The page carries the officer report, the decision notice and the minutes of the meeting, and shows the item in the context of a long agenda that also included the council's 2026-2027 budget.
